hypothesis: One epoch of top-two-layer masked-language-model adaptation on rights-cleared Hippocorpus recalled summaries will reduce author-isolated held-out MLM loss without materially degrading the historical incumbent on the same frozen development diagnostics.

corpus.text: complete recalled summaries of at most 300 Unicode characters; no truncation

initialization.encoder: existing historical candidate-c checkpoint (SamLowe/roberta-base-go_emotions lineage; Reddit-derived underlying training-data rights unresolved; not production-cleared)

decisionRule: RETAIN_RESEARCH_CANDIDATE only if held-out MLM loss decreases, frozen-development micro-F1 drops by no more than 0.02, no label with support >=3 drops more than 0.10 F1, and false positives per row increase by no more than 0.05; this is not a model-promotion rule.

evaluationLimits.frozenDevelopment: same 149-row historical development diagnostic for incumbent and candidate; labels are not independent rights-cleared human gold
